The '''Hindasar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TMTSB">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
Hindasar became a temporary hiding place for the notorious Doctor [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] after he escaped a prison on [[Delrian/Legends|Delrian]]. During his stay in the system, Evazan obtained a forged medical license and set up a medical practice as a cover for his grotesque activities.<ref name="TMTSB" /> The victims of his surgeries later banded together to post a bounty on his head.<ref name="DEITDB">{{DB|character|doctorevazan|Evazan, Doctor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hindasar is one the "twelve systems" where Dr. Evazan has a death sentence, as he mentions to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]].

In ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'', it is spelled '''Hindsaar'''.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
